title: ops_health inputSchema
description: Argument shape for the platform-operations health tool (advertised name honua_ops_health). Read-only: returns a single consolidated operational-health snapshot mirroring the honua-server admin endpoint GET /api/v1/admin/observability/ops-health (health-check roll-up, serving latency, geoprocessing queue depth, alert-dispatch backlog, coordinated-deploy readiness + platform-release skew, database/cache utilization). Takes no arguments. The response payload is the honua://ops/health resource projection (see resources/ops-health.schema.json). x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.
